categories.main_business_segments: China Resources Microelectronics Limited (华润微电子有限公司) operates primarily in two business segments: Products and Solutions, and Manufacturing and Services. The Products and Solutions segment focuses on power semiconductors, intelligent sensors, and intelligent control products, while the Manufacturing and Services segment provides wafer fabrication, mask making, and packaging and testing services. The company is a leading IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) in China with a comprehensive semiconductor industry chain including chip design, mask manufacturing, wafer fabrication, and packaging/testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in MOSFET, IGBT, SiC and GaN power devices, BCD process technology, MEMS technology, and advanced packaging such as IPM modules and panel-level fan-out packaging. It employs IDM manufacturing methods integrating design and production, enabling rapid product iteration and customization. The company also advances third-generation semiconductor materials (SiC and GaN) and has developed multiple technology platforms including 0.11um CMOS, BCD, HVIC, and CMOS-MEMS. It emphasizes R&D with structured development stages from project initiation to mass production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span automotive electronics, consumer electronics, industrial equipment, and communication devices. The company serves leading domestic automotive manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers with automotive-grade MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC modules, and power ICs. Other major markets include new energy vehicles, AI servers, home appliances, mobile phones, and smart wearables. The company also provides manufacturing services to domestic and international semiconductor firms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and major facilities in Wuxi, Shanghai, Chongqing, Shenzhen, and Dalian. It serves domestic markets extensively and exports to other countries. Overseas assets and operations are limited, with a small portion of assets and revenues from international markets. The company is registered in the Cayman Islands but operates primarily in mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Resources Microelectronics is positioned as an IDM, covering upstream chip design, midstream wafer fabrication and mask making, and downstream packaging and testing. It controls the full semiconductor production chain, enabling integration and control over product quality and innovation. It also provides foundry and packaging services to other semiconductor companies, acting as a midstream and downstream supplier in the semiconductor supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, focusing on power semiconductors, intelligent sensors, and intelligent control products. It advances third-generation semiconductor materials (SiC and GaN) and develops automotive-grade and industrial-grade products. Strategic initiatives include expanding 12-inch wafer production lines, enhancing advanced packaging capabilities, and pursuing import substitution in China. The company also emphasizes talent development, technology innovation, and industry collaboration to maintain technological leadership and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of power semiconductors, sensors, and integrated circuits, as well as manufacturing services including wafer fabrication, mask making, and packaging/testing. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distributor channels. It also earns government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue model is product and service sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of China's largest power semiconductor manufacturers and a leading IDM in the domestic semiconductor industry. It ranks second among Chinese power semiconductor companies and first in MOSFET scale domestically. It competes with international semiconductor firms and domestic peers in power devices, sensors, and ICs. The company leverages its full industry chain integration and advanced technology platforms to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 10.12 billion, a 2.2% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 762 million, reflecting a decline due to intensified price competition and increased R&D and capital expenditures. Total assets stood at RMB 29.1 billion with equity of RMB 22.3 billion. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio (~11.5% of revenue) and is expanding production capacity with new 12-inch wafer lines. Despite profit pressure, cash flow from operations improved by 17.17%. The company is in a growth phase with strategic investments and industry consolidation plans.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive IDM model integrating design, manufacturing, and packaging, enabling rapid product iteration and customization. It offers a broad and advanced product portfolio in power semiconductors, including automotive-grade and third-generation wide bandgap devices (SiC, GaN), with strong domestic brand recognition. Its advanced manufacturing capabilities, proprietary technologies, and strong R&D team provide differentiated high-performance, reliable, and cost-effective semiconductor solutions tailored to new energy, automotive, industrial, and consumer markets. The company also focuses on supply chain security and ESG integration as part of its value proposition.
